meta.title: Extend a round beyond the auction's end
gaps: Explicitly set the knockout round end time beyond the auction's separate expiry time; extend_time can request a time relative to the current end but cannot reference the auction expiry boundary directly.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Explicitly set the knockout round end time beyond the auction's separate expiry time; extend_time can request a time relative to the current end but cannot reference the auction expiry boundary directly.

plan.title: Reject knockout round extension past auction expiry

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live knockout auction on the buyer's summary page.

args.message: You cannot extend round time beyond auction expiry time

steps.note: Attempt to extend the current round beyond its current end and verify Procol refuses it with the auction-expiry message.
